items.title: Former president of Kosovo Hashim Thaçi sentenced to 25 years in prison for war crimes
items.description: The special court in The Hague found the former leader of the Kosovo Liberation Army guilty of arbitrary detentions, torture, and murders committed during the 1998-1999 war.

items.title: For some Israelis, criticizing the military’s conduct in Gaza is beyond the pale
items.description: A new Israeli documentary about the military’s conduct in the Gaza war has brought accusations of “treason” from some of Israel’s leaders.

items.title: Saudi Arabia accuses Houthis of targeting Mecca, calls it a 'red line'
items.description: Saudi Arabia accused Yemen’s Houthis on Wednesday of launching an attack on the holy city of Mecca, which the Iran-backed rebels denied. Saudi Arabia, a US ally which has been the target of large-scale Houthi strikes since early September, declared Mecca a “red line” as it slid deeper into the new front of the Iran war…

items.title: Russian Drones Hit Ukrainian Passenger Train And Bus, Killing 5
items.description: Russian drones hit a passenger train in southern Ukraine on September 16, setting a train ablaze. No causalities were reported. Another Russian drone strike killed five people on a bus near the frontline city of Nikopol, according to officials. The strikes follow an uptick in attacks on civilian transport in recent day…

items.title: How the Houthis are also putting Egypt under pressure
items.description: The Houthis, a Yemeni rebel group, are expanding their control of maritime corridors in the Red Sea area. Their target is their avowed enemy Saudi Arabia. But the military moves also endanger Egypt.

items.title: Kosovo's ex-President Thaci convicted of war crimes, sentenced to 25 years in prison
items.description: A European Union-backed court convicted former Kosovo President Hashim Thaci of war crimes committed during his country's war for independence from Serbia and sentenced him to 25 years in prison.

items.title: Ukraine Reports 219 Frontline Clashes as Fighting Intensifies Near Pokrovsk
items.description: The General Staff of the Armed Forces of Ukraine (AFU) reported 219 combat engagements by 10 p.m. local time on Tuesday, Sept. 15, with the heaviest fighting concentrated on the Pokrovsk axis. Russian forces reportedly launched 68 airstrikes, dropped 249 guided aerial bombs (KABs) and deployed 4,153 loitering munitions…

items.description: The ministry accused Western politicians of “blatantly ignoring” the warnings of their own governments against visiting war-torn Ukraine.

items.title: What weapon could the US have put into space?
items.description: The announcement by the US points to a developing field of modern warfare in the Earth's orbit.

items.title: Six UN staff killed in Gaza school strike; Lebanon violations mount
items.description: Israeli strikes killed six UN workers and civilians at a school sheltering displaced families in Gaza as needs grow, according to the UN agency for Palestine refugees, UNRWA.
